RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_OldManGreetin:
When I was young, I traveled the world as a POKéMON TRAINER.
Now that I've become an old buzzard, my only amusement is watching young TRAINERS battle.
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked: The door appears to be locked.
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_ChallengeVisi:
A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is visiting my home.
Would you like to challenge {STR_VAR_1}?
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_YouWontBattle: You won't battle? I'm disappointed that I can't see you battle…
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_KeepItToA3On3:
Oh, good, good!
But my house isn't all that sturdy.
Could I ask you to keep it down to a 3-on-3 match?
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_SaveYourProgr: Before you two battle, you should save your progress.
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_HopeToSeeAGoo: I hope to see a good match!
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleTie:
So, it became a standoff.
It was a brilliant match in which neither side conceded a step!
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleWon:
That was superlative!
Why, it was like seeing myself in my youth again!
RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_BattleLost:
Ah, too bad for you!
But it was a good match. I hope you can win next time.
